analysis.overall: A mixed day with 73% time in range, characterized by good stability around dinner offset by a stubborn late-night high and a lingering early morning low.

events.title: Early evening low and quick bounce
events.description: Glucose dipped to 66 mg/dL before rebounding quickly up to 159 mg/dL over the following half hour.

events.title: Late-night spike
events.description: Starting around 11:00 PM, glucose steadily rose and peaked at 249 mg/dL despite multiple small correction boluses.

events.title: Extended early morning low
events.description: The cumulative effect of late-night correction insulin kept glucose hovering low between 60–67 mg/dL for over an hour.

events.title: Afternoon surge after lunch
events.description: Starting from an elevated pre-meal reading, levels continued to climb post-lunch, topping out at 254 mg/dL.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Watch out for stacking multiple small corrections during late-night highs, as the delayed peak can drive extended lows around sunrise.
